description: Source code for zmalloc, a memory allocation wrapper with memory tracking and OS-specific memory info functions, used in Redis.

methods.name: zmalloc
methods.description: Allocate memory with tracking and OS-specific info.

methods.name: ztrymalloc
methods.description: Attempt to allocate memory, return NULL on failure.

methods.name: zmalloc_usable
methods.description: Allocate memory and get usable size.

methods.name: ztrycalloc
methods.description: Attempt to allocate zeroed memory, return NULL on failure.

methods.name: ztryrealloc
methods.description: Attempt to reallocate memory, return NULL on failure.

methods.name: zmadvise_dontneed
methods.description: Use MADV_DONTNEED to release memory to OS.

methods.name: zfree_usable
methods.description: Free memory and get usable size.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_rss
methods.description: Get resident set size (RSS) in bytes.

methods.name: set_jemalloc_bg_thread
methods.description: Enable or disable jemalloc background thread.

methods.name: zmalloc_get_smap_bytes_by_field
methods.description: Get smaps field bytes in OS-specific way.
